dealer_positioning.volatility_behavior: Above roughly 7733-7775, positive-gamma models imply hedging that can dampen moves or pin strikes. A futures-indicated lower opening near or below the transition band could expose short-gamma behavior, with dealers potentially reinforcing declines and rallies. The 7700 strike carries the largest near-spot negative modeled gamma in the SquawkFlow heatmap (-6.1B across the displayed expirations); a break below 7700 could increase downside fragility. These are conditional heuristics.
